correctness.rationale: Reconstructed all quantifiers and boundary ranks. The uniform signed-permutation orbit has mean zero and variance 1/d; from rank four its cubic moment vanishes. The nonnegative cubic support polynomial bounds the maximum and at equality forces every projection to equal ±1/sqrt(d). Walsh degree-two characters are distinct for d>=5 but complementary in d=4, producing exactly the classified strata. For d=3 the quadratic support polynomial forces a tetrahedral orbit and opposite parity. A direct 2x2 singular-value calculation yields the rank-one norm identity; the package checker verifies finite boundary cases independently of the infinite proof.
